entries.headline: Deep-dive backfill: 21 jurisdictions, 75 verified fee items
entries.detail: Backfilled the 21 deep-dive cities whose posts were published but missing from the /compare/ calculator: Alhambra, Campbell, Chula Vista, Downey, Fontana, Fremont, Laguna Beach, Lakewood, Lancaster, Oceanside, Ontario, Oxnard, Pasadena, Salinas, San Bernardino, Santa Ana, Santa Barbara, Santa Monica, Santa Rosa, West Covina, Westminster. CONFIRMED-only: computed examples, ranges, proportional-to-primary figures, and unverifiable items excluded (notably the Oceanside blanket ADU impact exemption, which conflicts with the city's Aug 2025 park DIF nexus draft and needs post-level review). Every item carries a verified official source URL.

entries.headline: Batch 18: 5 new jurisdictions, 12 verified fee items
entries.detail: Hemet, Sunnyvale, Marin County, Jurupa Valley, San Fernando (HCD ADU-permit ranks #105–109). Hemet's $8.647/SF DIF ($6,918 on 800 sq ft) is the matrix's steepest 750-sq-ft cliff; Jurupa Valley runs its own DIF program (Ch. 3.75); Marin County shows special-district fragmentation. Proportional-to-primary fees (Jurupa DIF/MSHCP) and track-ambiguous permit tiers held back as PARTIAL.

entries.headline: Batch 17: 5 new jurisdictions, 9 verified fee items
entries.detail: Pico Rivera, Saratoga, Mountain View, El Cajon, El Dorado County (HCD ADU-permit ranks #100–104). First East County San Diego and El Dorado County coverage; Mountain View's two-district school split ($5.24/sq ft) is the matrix's first; El Dorado County's $1,320 fire fee drops ~94% under SB 1117. Derived/proportional figures (Saratoga elementary $3.72, per-DFU sewer) held back as PARTIAL.

entries.headline: Batch 16: 5 new jurisdictions, 5 verified fee items
entries.detail: Davis, Temple City, Palmdale, Redwood City, Bakersfield (HCD ADU-permit ranks #95–99). First Yolo County coverage; Redwood City's $1.78/sq ft ADU sewer line is explicit in ordinance; Bakersfield's stacked 2016-dated DIFs held back as PARTIAL. Also merged the duplicate Santa Clara County entry.
Tracy, Hayward, Coachella, Rancho Cucamonga, Richmond (HCD ADU-permit ranks #89–94). Hayward's $5,295 sewer line is the matrix's first explicit 'all ADUs pay utilities' case.
